de.text: Das im Jahr 960 gegründete geistliche Zentrum der Stadt beherbergt Gräber von sechs Erzbischöfen.

de.name: Surrey Street Market

en.name: Croydon Minster

en.name: Whitgift Almshouses
en.text: Elizabethan buildings founded in 1596 by Archbishop John Whitgift to provide care for the needy.

en.name: Museum of Croydon
en.text: Located within the Clocktower complex, it showcases the town's history and the Riesco collection of ceramics.

en.name: Fairfield Halls
en.text: An arts complex opened in 1962, featuring a world-renowned concert hall and a professional theater.

en.name: Addington Palace
en.text: An 18th-century mansion that was once the summer residence of the Archbishops of Canterbury.

en.name: Shirley Windmill

en.name: Wandle Park

en.name: Lloyd Park

en.name: Coombe Wood

en.name: South Norwood Lake

en.name: Boxpark Croydon
en.text: A modern food and entertainment hub constructed from shipping containers next to East Croydon station.

en.name: Old Palace
en.text: A 12th-century building that served as an archiepiscopal residence for over five hundred years.

en.name: Saffron Square
en.text: A landmark residential development with a colorful facade and a vibrant new public square.

en.name: Surrey Street Market
en.text: Operating since 1276, this is one of the oldest and busiest traditional street markets in Britain.

en.name: Croydon Clocktower
en.text: A grand Victorian red-brick building opened in 1893, housing the central library and a cinema.

en.name: Bethlem Museum of the Mind
en.text: A museum located at Bethlem Royal Hospital, exploring the history of mental healthcare through art.

en.name: Kenley Aerodrome
en.text: A former Royal Air Force station that was a vital fighter base during the Battle of Britain in 1940.

en.name: West Croydon Station
en.text: Opened in 1839, this transport hub connects train, bus, and tram services in the north of the town.

en.name: East Croydon Station

en.name: Addington Hills
en.text: A large area of heathland offering panoramic views over the London skyline and the North Downs.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Croydon, ein urbaner Mittelpunkt im Süden Londons, hat sich in den letzten Jahrzehnten von einer Marktstadt zu einem der wichtigsten kommerziellen und administrativen Zentren der britischen Hauptstadt entwickelt. Die Skyline von Croydon ist geprägt von zahlreichen Bürogebäuden, die viele Dienstleistungsunternehmen und Behörden beherbergen. Als Einkaufshub zieht die Stadt regelmäßig tausende Menschen aus der Umgebung an, was durch den ausgebauten öffentlichen Nahverkehr und eine exzellente Bahnanbindung unterstützt wird. Trotz seines urbanen, modernen Charakters bietet Croydon auch historischen Charme in einigen seiner älteren Viertel. Die Stadt verfolgt ambitionierte Pläne zur weiteren urbanen Regeneration, um die Attraktivität für Bewohner und Unternehmen kontinuierlich zu steigern und die Position als führendes Zentrum im Süden Londons zu festigen.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Croydon, London déli részének egyik városi központja, az elmúlt évtizedekben piactérből a brit főváros egyik legfontosabb kereskedelmi és közigazgatási központjává fejlődött. Croydon látképét számos irodaház jellemzi, amelyek sok szolgáltató cégnek és hatóságnak adnak otthont. Bevásárlóközpontként a város rendszeresen vonzza a környékbeliek ezreit, amit a kiterjesztett tömegközlekedés és a kiváló vasúti összeköttetés is támogat. Városi, modern jellege ellenére Croydon történelmi bájt is kínál régebbi negyedeinek némelyikében. A város ambiciózus terveket követ a további városi regeneráció érdekében, hogy folyamatosan növelje a vonzerejét a lakók és a vállalkozások számára, és megszilárdítsa pozícióját London déli részének vezető központjaként.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Croydon, un punct central urban în sudul Londrei, s-a dezvoltat în ultimele decenii dintr-un oraș comercial într-unul dintre cele mai importante centre comerciale și administrative ale capitalei britanice. Orizontul orașului Croydon este marcat de numeroase clădiri de birouri care găzduiesc multe companii de servicii și autorități. Ca nod comercial, orașul atrage regulat mii de oameni din împrejurimi, ceea ce este susținut de transportul public extins și de o conexiune feroviară excelentă. În ciuda caracterului său urban și modern, Croydon oferă, de asemenea, farmec istoric în unele dintre cartierele sale mai vechi. Orașul urmărește planuri ambițioase pentru regenerarea urbană continuă, pentru a crește constant atractivitatea pentru rezidenți și companii și pentru a-și consolida poziția ca centru principal în sudul Londrei.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Croydon, an urban hub in the south of London, has developed in recent decades from a market town into one of the most important commercial and administrative centres of the British capital. Croydon's skyline is characterised by numerous office buildings that house many service companies and government agencies. As a shopping hub, the city regularly attracts thousands of people from the surrounding area, which is supported by extensive public transport and excellent railway links. Despite its urban, modern character, Croydon also offers historical charm in some of its older neighbourhoods. The city is pursuing ambitious plans for further urban regeneration to continuously increase its attractiveness for residents and businesses and to consolidate its position as a leading centre in the south of London.
